title: Why Your Resume Isn’t Getting Interviews (Good vs Bad Examples)
description:
Most resumes don’t fail because you’re not qualified—they fail because they’re hard to read.

In this video, I break down a real example of a bad resume vs a good one, showing you exactly what’s not working and how to fix it. You’ll see the difference side by side so you can understand what recruiters actually look for and how to make your resume stand out in those first few seconds.

We go section by section, covering:
• Resume layout and structure
• What to remove (photos, graphics, columns, clutter)
• How to write stronger, more effective bullet points
• What recruiters actually notice when they scan your resume

If you’ve been applying and not hearing back, this will help you see what’s likely going wrong—and how to fix it.
If you need more support creating a resume that gets picked, check out my Get Seen Guide below:
